title: The spectrum of f(x) = x² + 1 is its range
caption: f − λ fails to be invertible exactly when it vanishes somewhere on [0, 1], that is, when λ is a value f takes. f rises from 1 to 2, so σ(f) = [1, 2].
alt: The curve y = x squared plus 1 over 0 to 1, rising from (0, 1) to (1, 2), with the heights from 1 to 2 on the vertical axis highlighted.
description: f(x) = x² + 1 on [0, 1] rises steadily from f(0) = 1 to f(1) = 2.
f − λ has a zero exactly when λ is a height f reaches.
Every value between 1 and 2 is reached, so the spectrum is the whole interval [1, 2].

checks.name: the smallest value of f on [0, 1] is 1
the largest value of f on [0, 1] is 2
